A Dedekind cut is a downward-closed, non-empty proper subset of $\mathbb{Q}$ with no greatest element.

== Formal definition ==

{{#content:Q2400}}

== Properties ==

=== $A \subset \mathbb{Q},\, A \ne \emptyset$ (Non-empty proper subset of rational numbers) ===

from definition.

=== $q \in A, q_1\lt q \Rightarrow q_1 \in A$ (Downward-complete) ===

from order of rational numbers.

=== $\forall q \in A: \exists q_1 \in A,\, q_1>q$ (No greatest element) ===

{{Hidden proof}}
If $q \in \mathbb{Q}$, $\exists a,b \in \mathbb{N}, q = \frac{a}{b}$.

Let $q_1=\frac{a+1}{b}$, then $q_1 \in \mathbb{Q},\, q_1>q$.

{{End hidden}}
